description: Tests that in assessment phase, agent asks direct questions, not 'do you want to...?'. Agent should already have seen the complete code and walkthrough.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who has just finished a working solution and walked the interviewer through it. The tests all passed. You're now waiting for the interviewer's wrap-up questions. Respond briefly to whatever they ask.
simulated_user.first_message: Alright, so that's the full solution and walkthrough. What else do you want to go over?

partial_conversation_history.message: I'll use a hash map — store values as I iterate and check for complements. O(n) time, O(n) space.
Sounds like a plan. Go ahead and implement it.
Okay, done coding. I think it looks right.
Nice — walk me through your solution.

Sure. As I iterate through the array, for each element I check if the complement exists in the hash map. If it does, I return the pair. Otherwise I store the current value. It handles all cases correctly.
Good explanation. And the tests all pass.

evaluation_criteria.name: Leads with direct questions
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent asked direct interview questions (e.g. 'what's the time complexity?', 'why did you choose this structure?') rather than offering a menu ('do you want to discuss complexity?', 'should we...?'). PASS if it led with direct questions and did not ask permission or offer options.
